decisions.reason: A single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core heat-exchange offer, uses existing manufacturing and sales channels, and there is no sign of a performance shortfall that would trigger search or divestment.
This core-adjacent condenser fits the firm's established portfolio and its low incremental cost can be carried by slack while results are still early.
C closely resembles B, so there is a modest risk of consolidation, but it adds little extra cost and stays within established routines, so management keeps it.
The tube liner supports the firm's strategic push into lifecycle services, where aftermarket revenue tends to meet aspirations, so there is no reason to drop it.
Customized air coolers are central to the firm's integrated-solution strategy, and a multi-model line is unlikely to be withdrawn within one year.
The tube end repair inserts strengthen the service portfolio at low cost and are consistent with the firm's maintenance and repair focus.
